# Research plan: values of ±1-coefficient correlator expressions on deterministic (2,2,2) strategies

**ID**: `cpt-qi-rplan-chsh-det`

## Table of Contents

<!-- generated by `cfs toc` -->

## Research Question

Verbatim: *"In the (2,2,2) Bell scenario — two parties, two settings each, ±1 outcomes — which values can a correlator expression with ±1 coefficients take on deterministic strategies, and is the CHSH bound of 2 provable in Lean from the definitions alone?"*

Object class: deterministic strategies (a₀, a₁, b₀, b₁) ∈ {+1, −1}⁴ and expressions E = Σ_{x,y} c_xy · a_x · b_y with c_xy ∈ {+1, −1}. Deliverables: a proved CONJECTURE for the CHSH bound with a passing tier-C PROOF-ATTEMPT; any over-generalization refuted with a witness; a candidate for the correct generalization registered with exact evidence. Withheld from the agent: nothing (this is the kit's worked example; the statements are classical and the point is the pipeline).

*Kit note: this plan is the canonical example of the discovery layer. It is deliberately small so that every artifact below is reproducible in seconds with core Lean and no Mathlib; a real plan has the same shape with real figures.*

## Prior Knowledge

| Statement | Source or Mathlib declaration | Verified / assumed | Checked by (how, date) |
|-----------|-------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------|
| Local (and hence deterministic) CHSH bound \|S\| ≤ 2 | Clauser, Horne, Shimony, Holt, Phys. Rev. Lett. 23, 880 (1969) | assumed — recalled, not re-located; the run proves the deterministic case itself and cites nothing | — |
| Vertices of the local polytope are the deterministic strategies (so the convex bound equals the deterministic one) | Fine, Phys. Rev. Lett. 48, 291 (1982) | assumed — out of scope: the run's statements are about deterministic strategies only (P6) | — |
| Decidable order and equality on `Int` | core Lean: `Int.decLe`, `Int.decEq` | verified | `#check Int.decLe`, `#check Int.decEq` in `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`, 2026-10-13 |

Mathlib coverage: none needed; the project uses core `Bool` and `Int` only.

## Definitions Concordance

| Concept | Informal / source notation | Lean declaration (Mathlib or project file) | Checked by (how, date) | Note |
|---------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------|------------------------|------|
| Outcome encoding | a ∈ {+1, −1} | `Chsh.pm : Bool → Int` in `examples/qi/lean-chsh/Chsh.lean` | `#print Chsh.pm`, 2026-10-13 | `true ↦ 1`, `false ↦ -1` — encoding row (P2) |
| Deterministic strategy | (a₀, a₁, b₀, b₁) ∈ {±1}⁴ | four `Bool` arguments `a0 a1 b0 b1` | — | one outcome per setting; the Bool encoding is total, so quantifying over `Bool` is quantifying over all strategies |
| CHSH expression | S = a₀b₀ + a₀b₁ + a₁b₀ − a₁b₁ | `Chsh.chsh` in `Chsh.lean` | `#print Chsh.chsh`, 2026-10-13 | sign convention: the minus sign on the (1,1) term |
| Correlator expression with coefficients | E = Σ c_xy a_x b_y | `Chsh.bell c00 c01 c10 c11` in `Chsh.lean` | `#print Chsh.bell`, 2026-10-13 | coefficients are `Int`; `Chsh.chsh a0 a1 b0 b1 = Chsh.bell 1 1 1 (-1) a0 a1 b0 b1` for all arguments is provable by case split and `decide`, not by `rfl` (the two definitions are not definitionally equal) |
| ±1 coefficient | c ∈ {+1, −1} | hypothesis `c = 1 ∨ c = -1` | — | hypothesis form, one per coefficient |
| Odd number of negative coefficients | #{xy : c_xy = −1} odd | hypothesis `c00 * c01 * c10 * c11 = -1` | — | equivalent under the ±1 hypotheses |

## Phase Sequence

| # | Phase | Purpose | Produces | Gate |
|---|-------|---------|----------|------|
| 1 | EXPLORE | enumerate all 16 strategies for CHSH and all 16 sign patterns, exactly | `examples/qi/chsh-enumerate.py` output (the exploration record) | kit maintainer |
| 2 | PROPOSE | register the observed bound and its generalization, with compiled formal statements and faithfulness cross-checks (second-agent back-translation, `Instances.lean`) | `cpt-qi-conj-chsh-det-bound`, `cpt-qi-conj-bell-pm-coeff-values` | kit maintainer |
| 3 | CHECK | exact instance checks of every registered conjecture before any attempt | Evidence tables; the generalization's counterexample | kit maintainer |
| 4 | ATTEMPT | one tier-C attempt per conjecture: proof of the bound, refutation of the generalization | `cpt-qi-attempt-chsh-det-bound-lean`, `cpt-qi-attempt-bell-pm-coeff-values-refute` | kit maintainer |
| 5 | REPORT | register the restriction suggested by the refutation's handoff with its exact evidence; summarize | `cpt-qi-conj-bell-odd-sign-values` (supported; deliberately left unattempted so the example shows that state — the budget would allow 2 attempts) | kit maintainer |

## Conjecture Policy

| Origin | What must be stated | Typical trigger |
|--------|---------------------|-----------------|
| Generalization / specialization | the proved or cited statement (CONJECTURE, LEMMA or THEOREM ID) and what changes | a proof that did not use a hypothesis; a result known for n = 2 |
| Pattern in exploration | the exploration record, the instances and the pattern observed | exact enumeration over a finite scenario |
| Gap in an attempt | the PROOF-ATTEMPT ID and the remaining goal, quoted | a `sorry` in an `incomplete` attempt |
| Strengthening / weakening / restriction | the refuted or proved CONJECTURE ID and the hypothesis added or dropped | a counterexample that a hypothesis excludes |

Rules for this run: routes A (exact enumeration, as evidence) and C (Lean, as proof); an instance check is never skipped; allowed axiom set `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` (none of the example proofs needs any); an external theorem needed by an attempt becomes a `cited` LEMMA and a CONJECTURE to formalize, never an `axiom`. Independent reading of every formal statement (P13): a second agent instance started fresh and shown only `Chsh.lean`, the Definitions Concordance above and the Lean block — never a Statement section; instance agreement via `examples/qi/lean-chsh/Instances.lean` against `examples/qi/chsh-enumerate.py`; confirmation by the kit maintainer.

## Success Criteria

Frozen at: 2026-10-13, before the first attempt. Confirmed by: kit maintainer.

### Builds

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-builds`

**Scored quantity**: exit status and error count of the project build
**Threshold**: exit 0, 0 errors
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: mechanical: `lake build` in `examples/qi/lean-chsh`, by `attest_lean.py`
**Origin and justification**: proposed: nothing below is meaningful on a development that does not compile
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

### Sorry-free

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-sorry-free`

**Scored quantity**: presence of `sorryAx` in the axiom closure of the attested declaration
**Threshold**: absent
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: mechanical: `#print axioms` on the declaration, by `attest_lean.py` (the build exit code does not detect `sorry`)
**Origin and justification**: proposed: a declaration whose closure contains `sorryAx` is a statement, not a proof
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

### Axioms standard

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-axioms-standard`

**Scored quantity**: axioms in the closure of the attested declaration not in the allowed set
**Threshold**: 0 (allowed set: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`)
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: mechanical: `#print axioms`, by `attest_lean.py`
**Origin and justification**: proposed: an external theorem introduced as an `axiom` would make the build green without proving anything
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

### Statement matches

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-statement-matches`

**Scored quantity**: equality of the attested declaration's type with the CONJECTURE's Formal Statement (for a refutation: with its negation)
**Threshold**: equal up to whitespace
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: mechanical: `#check @decl` compared with the CONJECTURE's Formal Statement block, by `attest_lean.py`
**Origin and justification**: proposed: a green build of a different statement proves nothing about the conjecture
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

### Dependencies pinned

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-dependencies-pinned`

**Scored quantity**: packages in `lake-manifest.json` without a pinned revision; absence of `lean-toolchain`
**Threshold**: 0
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: mechanical: `lean-toolchain` and `lake-manifest.json`, by `attest_lean.py`
**Origin and justification**: proposed: an attempt that cannot be rebuilt bit-for-bit is not reproducible evidence
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

### Statement confirmed

**ID**: `cpt-qi-criterion-statement-confirmed`

**Scored quantity**: the CONJECTURE's Faithfulness Cross-Check — independent reading (back-translation by a second agent instance that did not write the Lean block and was not shown the Statement; element table all `yes`; discrepancies resolved), instance agreement (`examples/qi/lean-chsh/Instances.lean` against `examples/qi/chsh-enumerate.py`), and a dated `Confirmed faithful by`
**Threshold**: complete, no open discrepancy
**Direction**: ==
**How measured**: judged by: a second agent instance (reading) and the kit maintainer (confirmation) — recorded in the CONJECTURE's Faithfulness Cross-Check; completeness checked and copied by `attest_lean.py`
**Origin and justification**: proposed: the compiler checks that the formal statement is well-typed, an independent reader checks that it says what the informal statement says (P13); without this row a proof of the wrong formalization passes every mechanical gate
**Confirmed by**: kit maintainer, 2026-10-13

## Stop Conditions

Attempt budget (6) or time box (1 h) exhausted; every registered conjecture proved, refuted or withdrawn; the maintainer stops the run; a toolchain failure fails the phase rather than being retried silently; an attempt exceeding the confirmed cost by a factor of 10 (i.e. more than 20 s of build) is a deviation raised before the next attempt; a change of a criterion or of the allowed axiom set closes this plan and opens a new one.

## Decisions Log

- *Scope:* offered (a) deterministic strategies only vs (b) the full local polytope (convex closure) vs (c) quantum strategies. Chosen: (a) — (b) needs Mathlib's convexity library and the example must build in core Lean in seconds; (c) is out of the question's scope. The convex bound is therefore `assumed` prior knowledge, not a result of this run (P6).
- *Routes:* offered tier A only (an enumeration script as the proof) vs tier C only vs both. Chosen: both — enumeration is the instance evidence (P4), Lean is the proof; the kit example must exercise `attest_lean.py` on a `pass` and on a `refuted` attempt.
- *Axiom set:* default three; no proof here needs any, so `#print axioms` reports none.
- *Budget:* two attempts per conjecture per route is enough for one-line `decide` proofs; a real plan quotes days.
- *Formal statements:* compiled from `examples/qi/lean-chsh/Stubs.lean` rather than typed, as CONJECTURE rule 2 requires.
- *Faithfulness cross-check (P13):* offered (a) the maintainer re-reads each Lean block against the Statement vs (b) a second agent instance, shown only the Lean code and the concordance, back-translates each block and the maintainer compares; plus instance agreement via `Instances.lean`. Chosen: (b) + instances — (a) has the author checking the author; the back-translations are quoted verbatim in each CONJECTURE and surfaced two remarks (the generalization is false as written — intended; the ±1 hypotheses of the odd-sign conjecture are redundant over ℤ — kept, noted for the handoff).
